detaileddescription.para: Doxygen rendering of the annotated ZTEST() functions of the Safe Data API test application (tests/safe_data). The group hierarchy models the test structure:

listitem.para:
Safe Data API Tests (Safe Data API Tests)
Safe Data Test Suites (Safe Data Test Suites)
Safe Data Test Application (Safe Data Test Application, one per test app)
ztest suite safe_data (one doxygen group per ZTEST_SUITE())

detaileddescription.para: The Sphinx test specification consumes the XML output of this build via the testmodule directive and turns every test case into a traceable sphinx-needs item.
